description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120). Tables without a primary key: XC4 (index ZZ_G on G made first, then AA_N on N), XC5 (AA_G on G first, then ZZ_N on N), XD4 (ZZ_N on N ascending first, then AA_ND on N DESC), XD5 (AA_N on N ascending first, then ZZ_ND on N DESC). For each: a dynaset of SELECT ID, s FROM t. Asks whether the index name or the index itself (its distinct keys, its direction) decides which index an unrestricted dynaset follows. Rows (ID, N, G) inserted (5, 3, 1), (2, 7, 2), (8, 1, 1), (1, 6, 2), (7, 4, 1), (3, 8, 2), (6, 2, 1), (4, 5, 2), s 'r1' to 'r8' in insertion order; indexes made before the rows.
